source.section: s.3.1.1.1: maximum FSR 0.60; the Director of Planning may increase it to 0.75 (multiple dwelling, duplex, single detached house, rooming house and others) or 0.95 for infill retaining an existing building (conditional). s.3.1.1.2: 1.00 for multiple dwelling and seniors housing where at least 25% of the units are owned or leased by a government or non-profit housing society and secured as housing for persons with disabilities or low income. Multiple dwelling is a conditional use (s.2.1).

params.front_yard_note: The minimum front yard is the average of the front yards of the 2 adjacent sites on each side (a vacant adjacent site counts as 3.7 m); the maximum front yard is 3.7 m. No fixed minimum is entered, so the front is not tested.
params.side_yard_note: 1.5 m where the site is wider than 15.0 m; 10% of the site width where it is 15.0 m or less.
params.rear_yard_note: 20.0 m, less the distance from the rear property line to the ultimate centre line of a lane behind.

affordable_variance.needs: open to a multiple dwelling with at least 25% of its units owned or leased by a government or non-profit and secured for low income or disability, s.3.1.1.2

source.title: City of Vancouver Zoning and Development By-law, RM-4 District Schedule (consolidation dated October 2026)
source.section: s.3.1.1.2: for multiple dwelling and a mixed-use residential building that includes a child day care facility, the maximum floor space ratio is 1.45; s.3.1.1.3: 3.00 if 100% of the residential floor area is developed as social housing; s.3.1.1.1: developments requiring social housing are subject to Schedule J. Multiple dwelling is a conditional use (s.2.1) on a site of at least 550 m² (s.3.1.2.1). Other uses take 0.75 (s.3.5.1.1). The effective date is the consolidation's; the clauses may be older. RM-4N is not in this schedule and is not entered.

rules.title: CD-1 (324) maximum residential floor area by sub-area (800-1100 Pacific Blvd)

source.title: City of Vancouver CD-1 (324) By-law No. 7248, 800-1100 Pacific Boulevard (consolidated to By-law No. 14009, 23 Apr 2024)
source.section: s.6.2 and Table 1a [By-law 14009, 2024]: the residential floor area in sub-area A must not exceed 19,300 m² and in sub-area B 23,600 m²; the sub-areas are drawn on Schedule A (sub-area B is the triangle between Expo Blvd, Pacific Blvd and the Cambie Bridge approach). s.6.1 Table 1: 249,543 m² of residential floor area for the whole CD-1, which a site outside the sub-areas shares and this rule does not test. s.6.4 and 6.5: exclusions (balconies up to 12% of the residential floor area, amenity up to 10%). s.6.6: the Development Permit Board may permit up to 1% more within Table 2's neighbourhood totals. s.5.2: in sub-areas A and B at least 35% of the units must suit families, with two or more bedrooms (not tested by this rule). The effective date is By-law 14009's enactment.
source.read_from: inbox/cd-1(324).PDF (saved by hand from cd1-bylaws.vancouver.ca), pages 1, 4, 5, 7 and 11 (Schedule A)
